handoff: Changes requested. AC1–AC4 proven at S1, tests and typecheck green, AC5 is QA (agent). Blocking F1: upgrade runs git add on each relinked agent skill link by explicit path, so a repo that gitignores .claude/ fails midway (skills rewritten unstaged, no norn_version written). Minor F2: plain Error on a failed norn_version write. Nits F3 (unused import), F4 (backward check before the tick lock).

findings.title: Staging a relinked skill in a gitignored agent folder crashes upgrade midway
findings.detail:
versionPart pushes `relative(root, join(dir, n))` for every link linkSkills made and calls ctx.git.stage → `git add -- .claude/skills/<n>`. If the agent folder is ignored (`.claude/` in .gitignore — common), git refuses: "The following paths are ignored by one of your .gitignore files", exit 1 (reproduced in a scratch repo). The adapter's `must` throws, so upgrade exits with a git error, not a CliError, after installSkills already rewrote `.agents/skills/*` (unstaged) and before norn_version is written: a half-done upgrade, against D9's 'all staged' and B13's 'one staged diff'. A link in an ignored folder is never committed, so a fresh clone always lacks it and every upgrade there fails. init does not hit this: it only prints a `git add` suggestion.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Stage only link paths git does not ignore (e.g. filter with `git check-ignore`, or a git port helper), still report them as relinked; add an S1 test: `.claude/` in .gitignore, a missing link → upgrade exits 0, link recreated, nothing ignored staged, the rest staged.

findings.title: A failed norn_version write throws a plain Error, not a CliError
findings.detail:
`if (!w.ok) throw new Error(`norn upgrade: writing norn_version: ...`)` — P8 wants a CliError {error, do_instead, code}; the skills are already rewritten at this point and nothing is staged yet.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: refuse(...) with a do_instead (fix the team file, run again), or stage the skills before writing the version.

findings.title: Unused import existsSync
findings.detail:
`existsSync` is imported and never used.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Drop it.

findings.title: Backward check runs before the tick lock, not after it as D9 lists
findings.detail:
D9: 'main checkout only and the tick lock first … then the backward check before any write'. The code checks right after the main-checkout check, before the lock. It only reads, so it still is 'before any write' (even the lock file), and the comment says so; the one visible difference is an older binary under a running tick gets version_backward instead of tick_locked. Acceptable; noting the deviation.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: None needed; optionally note it in the spec's D9.
